about_the_game:
100 Men vs 1 Gorilla is a chaotic physics-based multiplayer battle game where a single overpowered gorilla faces off against a swarm of one hundred fragile, screaming humans. Will teamwork and sheer numbers win out—or will the gorilla turn the arena into a banana-scented bloodbath?

Welcome to MAN vs MONKEY: the ultimate test to settle the debate once and for all.

FEATURES

🦍 100 and 1 Multiplayer
Play as the unstoppable gorilla or one of 100 brave, poorly coordinated humans. Team up with strangers or friends in an all-out war against the mighty silverback Gorilla.

🎮 High intensity Combat
Can 200 fists defeat a Gorilla or is the Gorilla too strong for 100 tiny human men? It's all out mayhem with high intensity combat.

🧠 Herd Mentality
''Ape together strong'' - Human

🌴 Arena Madness
Battle across destructible, trap-filled arenas with hazards, climbable objects, and throwable nonsense. Watch people get launched into the stratosphere by a gorilla body slam.

👕 Cosmetics & Dumb Hats
Unlock ridiculous outfits like banana helmets, muscle suits, and “I Fought the Gorilla and All I Got Was This Shirt” t-shirts.

🎤 Meme-Ready Chaos
Screaming voice lines. Cinematic slow-mo moments. And enough ragdoll bodies to crash your grandma’s laptop.

Whether you're flinging fools as the GORILLAAAHH or trying to be the one human who actually lands a hit—100 Men vs. 1 Gorilla is the absurd brawler you absolutely knew you needed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 @2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 770 or AMD R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: May work with even lower specs
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 @3.0 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 or AMD RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: May work with even lower specs
